hooks.command: terminal-notifier -title "🔔 Claude Code" -message "Claude needs your input"

curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_BOT_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"channel\": \"$SLACK_USER_ID\", \"text\": \"🔔 Claude Code needs your input\"}" > /dev/null
terminal-notifier -title "✅ Claude Code" -message "The task has been completed"

curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_BOT_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"channel\": \"$SLACK_USER_ID\", \"text\": \"✅ Claude Code task completed\"}" > /dev/null
